executive_summary: Chairman-ordered corrective (RCA 9a02a76d) fixing the specific reason the fleet's one real alarm during a 14.6h output stall never surfaced: reaper_starvation_alert (and its 3 siblings) were structurally undeliverable at role='coordinator' (never registered in role_drain_sets/DRAIN_SETS.coordinator), the orphan-reroute-sweep rescue that eventually moved the row destroyed its severity by re-typing it to a generic 'coordinator_reminder', and its own repeat-offender alarm fired exactly once and never re-raised across the 9 days that followed. This SD closes all three, plus rewrites the starvation alert body to name the literal one-command fix (npm run resync:safe).

functional_requirements.title: Register the 4 reaper alert kinds as coordinator-deliverable
functional_requirements.description: reaper_starvation_alert, reaper_census_blind_alert, reaper_not_invoked_alert, reaper_rebuild_churn_alert added to DRAIN_SETS.coordinator (lib/fleet/worker-status.cjs) and to a chairman-gated role_drain_sets migration.
acceptance_criteria: The migration file exists with the same INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING pattern as prior role_drain_sets reconciliations.

functional_requirements.title: Severity-preserving orphan reroute
functional_requirements.description: orphan-reroute-sweep.js retargets a payload.severity==='high' orphan to REROUTE_TO_KIND_HIGH_SEVERITY ('coordinator_request') instead of the routine REROUTE_TO_KIND ('coordinator_reminder').
acceptance_criteria: A severity=high orphan reroutes to coordinator_request.
A non-high-severity orphan still reroutes to coordinator_reminder (no regression).

functional_requirements.title: Repeat-offender alarm re-arms over time
functional_requirements.description: The dedup check for a repeat-offender (role,kind) pair narrows from 'any unread alarm ever' to a REPEAT_OFFENDER_REALARM_MS (6h) freshness window, so a persisting offender re-alarms instead of going silent after its first alert.
acceptance_criteria: A pair past the threshold with no alarm inside the re-arm window alarms again.
A pair with a recent (in-window) unread alarm does not double-alarm.

functional_requirements.title: Name the literal fix command in the starvation alert body
functional_requirements.description: emitReaperStarvationAlert's non-blind, non-not-invoked, non-churn body names `npm run resync:safe` (scripts/safe-root-resync.mjs) as the first-line fix instead of vague 'investigate why fast-forward is blocked' prose.
acceptance_criteria: The alert body string literal includes 'npm run resync:safe'.
The safety contract (fetch+ff-merge only, stale-lock-clear gated behind two explicit flags) is described in the body.

functional_requirements.title: Zero regressions across the fleet/coordinator unit surface
functional_requirements.description: All existing behavior for non-high-severity reroutes, first-occurrence non-alarming, and the other 3 reaper alert kinds (blind/not-invoked/churn) is preserved unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: tests/unit/fleet/ and tests/unit/coordinator/ (276 files) pass with 0 failures.
No existing test's expected values changed except the 2 count pins this SD deliberately bumps (coordinator drain-set count, migration seed-row count).

technical_requirements.title: Rewrite the starvation alert body
technical_requirements.description: lib/coordinator/coordination-events.cjs's emitReaperStarvationAlert body names the literal sanctioned fix command (npm run resync:safe / scripts/safe-root-resync.mjs) instead of vague research-assignment prose.

test_scenarios.scenario: reaper_starvation_alert is now in DRAIN_SETS.coordinator and the seed migration
test_scenarios.expected: tests/unit/fleet/drain-set-registry.test.js and drain-sets-adam-reconciliation.test.js pass with updated counts.
orphan-reroute-sweep.test.js's re-alarm-past-threshold and recent-alarm-suppresses cases pass.

test_scenarios.scenario: Starvation alert body names the literal fix command
test_scenarios.expected: emitReaperStarvationAlert's non-blind/non-churn/non-not-invoked body string contains 'npm run resync:safe'.
tests/unit/fleet/ + tests/unit/coordinator/ (276 files, 3374 tests) pass with 0 failures.

acceptance_criteria: All 4 reaper alert kinds deliverable to role='coordinator'.
A high-severity orphan never downgrades to a routine reminder kind.
A persisting repeat-offender re-alarms after the re-arm window, not never again.
Full fleet/coordinator unit suite (276 files) passes with zero regressions.

risks.risk: The role_drain_sets migration is chairman-gated (@approved-by: PENDING) and not yet applied
risks.mitigation: DRAIN_SETS.coordinator (the in-memory fail-open fallback resolveRecognizedKinds reads when the DB table is unreadable/unapplied) already carries the fix, so the alert is deliverable today regardless of migration-apply timing; the migration closes the DB-authoritative path once approved.

risks.risk: Re-arming the repeat-offender alarm on a 6h window could still under- or over-alarm for some traffic patterns
risks.mitigation: 6h was chosen to sit well inside the RCA's measured 6h35m-to-14.6h stall windows while still being coarser than any single sweep tick; adjustable via the exported REPEAT_OFFENDER_REALARM_MS constant if real-world tuning is needed.

risks.risk: Ack-vocabulary unification and the orphan-reroute-sweep-cron last_state divergence (CAPA-4/6b) were descoped from this PR
risks.mitigation: Deliberately deferred as a fast-follow to keep this PR small and reviewable (LEO Small PRs guidance); tracked in the retrospective, not silently dropped.

consumers: the coordinator's generic inbox drain (consumes them)
observability_rollout: No rollout needed -- pure logic fix to an existing, already-running sweep and alert emitter.

system_architecture.summary: No new components. Fixes to 2 existing modules (orphan-reroute-sweep.js, coordination-events.cjs) plus a drain-set registration in worker-status.cjs + a chairman-gated migration.

implementation_approach.summary: Direct, already-implemented fix (see git diff) covering FR-1/2/3 and TR-1, fully unit-tested.
steps: Register reaper kinds in DRAIN_SETS.coordinator + migration
Narrow repeat-offender dedup to a time window, change threshold check to >=
Rewrite alert body with literal fix command
Update/extend unit tests, verify zero regressions across tests/unit/fleet + tests/unit/coordinator
